chunks.content:
**F.No. IRDA/IAC/20/78/2013:-ln** exercise of the powers conferred by sub section (1) of Section 25 of the Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority Act, 1999 (41 of 1999), and in terms of Regulation 3A of the IRDA [Insurance Advisory Committee (Meetings)] (First Amendment) Regulations, 2012 the Authority 3 ['lfTI m-= 4] hereby makes the following notification reconstituting the Insurance Advisory Committee with effect trom the date of notification viz 15th May 2013.
